decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal to power out powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga and Chalice of the Void. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist provide additional value by recurring artifacts and creating token creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruptive spells like Force of Will and efficient card draw with cards like Thoughtcast. The key strategy is to establish a strong board presence with artifacts and pressure the opponent with aggressive plays.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of Counterspells, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, and card draw/filtering with Ponder and Brainstorm. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of Day's Undoing provides a unique way to reset the game while benefiting the controller. The creatures Comet, Stellar Pup, The Wandering Emperor, Murktide Regent, and Hullbreacher offer additional threats and utility to help secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a combination of cards that can deal infect damage to the opponent, potentially winning the game in just a few turns. The deck uses mana accelerators like Chrome Mox and spirit guides to cast powerful creatures and disruptive spells early on. Cards like Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide the necessary infect creatures to close out the game, while other cards like Fury and Magus of the Moon help control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and focused on achieving a quick victory through infect damage.

The focus of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Narset, Parter of Veils while also generating card advantage with spells like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck aims to control the board and tempo of the game, eventually stabilizing and closing out the game with powerful finishers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Shark Typhoon. The inclusion of cards like Dress Down and Supreme Verdict allows for flexibility in handling a variety of threats, making it a versatile and adaptable control deck.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's deck. It also uses cards like Goblin Engineer to tutor for key pieces and disrupt the opponent with cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast. Additionally, it includes powerful cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Fury for additional disruption and win conditions. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo while controlling the board to secure victory in the Legacy format.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and quickly deploy powerful threats to apply pressure. By utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes, this aggro deck aims to control the game and dictate the pace. With fast mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox, along with powerful creatures like Anje's Ravager and Fury, this deck looks to overwhelm the opponent early on and secure a quick victory by leveraging its high initiative.

This deck focuses on using powerful artifacts and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It combines card advantage with mana acceleration to play threats early and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist to generate value, and using efficient artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Mox Opal to control the board, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and win the game through fast, aggressive plays.

The main strategy of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board while also putting pressure on them through aggressive creatures like Baleful Strix and Tombstalker. The deck utilizes cards like Hymn to Tourach and Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand while also using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out. The deck also has the ability to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Leovold, Emissary of Trest to further pressure the opponent. The mana base is designed to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors for spells and activate Wasteland as disruption.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to manipulate the game with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder while keeping the board in check with spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The inclusion of cards like Snapcaster Mage and Faerie Mastermind allows for flexibility and recursion, making it a versatile and adaptable control deck in the Legacy format.

The deck relies on using Emry, Lurker of the Loch to continually recur artifacts like Painter's Servant and Grindstone to assemble the combo win condition. Thought Monitor and Thoughtcast facilitate card draw to find combo pieces quickly. Kappa Cannoneer provides removal, while Force of Will offers protection. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Metallic Rebuke and Pithing Needle to control the board. Urza's Saga can tutor for key artifacts, and Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal help ramp and fix mana. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble the Painter combo while disrupting opponents' strategies.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence of aggressive goblin creatures by utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Conspicuous Snoop to cheat out powerful creatures like Muxus, Goblin Grandee. The deck also includes cards like Sling-Gang Lieutenant and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker to generate additional value and close out games. Additionally, the deck runs cards like Food Chain and Fury to provide additional utility and removal options. With a blend of efficient creatures and powerful combos, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with speed and aggression.

The deck revolves around quickly generating mana through cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond to cast powerful spells like Ad Nauseam and Burning Wish, allowing the player to search for specific cards needed to win the game. The deck also utilizes cards like Galvanic Relay and Veil of Summer to protect its combo pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. By carefully managing resources and leveraging cards like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal, the deck aims to generate a storm count high enough to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and win the game in a single turn.
